 "data": "
erDiagram
 Dim_Date ||--o{ Fact_Orders : order_date
 Dim_Date ||--o{ Fact_OrderItems : order_date

 Dim_Customer ||--o{ Fact_Orders : places
 Dim_PaymentMethod ||--o{ Fact_Orders : paid_by

 Fact_Orders ||--|{ Fact_OrderItems : contains
 Dim_Product ||--o{ Fact_OrderItems : includes

 Dim_Date {
 int date_key PK
 date full_date
 int year_num
 int quarter_num
 int month_num
 string month_name
 string month_year
 int day_of_month
 string day_of_week
 string day_name
 boolean is_weekend
 int fiscal_year
 }

 Fact_Orders {
 int order_id PK
 int customer_key FK
 int payment_method_key FK
 int order_date_key FK
 string order_status
 decimal grand_total
 }

 Fact_OrderItems {
 int order_detail_id PK
 int order_id FK
 int product_key FK
 int order_date_key FK
 int qty_ordered
 decimal unit_price
 decimal discount_amount
 decimal total_amount
 }

 Dim_Customer {
 int customer_key PK
 date customer_since
 }

 Dim_PaymentMethod {
 int payment_method_key PK
 string payment_method_name
 string payment_channel
 }

 Dim_Product {
 int product_key PK
 string sku
 string category_name
 decimal catalog_price
 }
